name: highfivery/zero-spam-for-wordpress
description: No spam, no scams, just seamless experiences with Zero Spam for WordPress - the shield your site deserves.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'Git hooks installed from .githooks/'

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run the full WordPress Coding Standards ruleset on every PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the WPCS violations phpcbf can handle.
scripts-descriptions.lint:changed: Run WPCS only on PHP files changed against origin/develop (what the pre-push hook runs).
scripts-descriptions.lint:tests: Run WPCS on the PHPUnit test code (phpcs.tests.xml.dist).
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan (level 5, WordPress + WP-CLI stubs) against the baseline.
scripts-descriptions.analyse:baseline: Regenerate phpstan-baseline.neon. Only do this when intentionally accepting new debt.
scripts-descriptions.version:check: Verify the plugin header, ZEROSPAM_VERSION and readme.txt Stable tag agree and never go backwards.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite on single site and multisite (latest WordPress, PHP on PATH). Needs MySQL.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run only the unit test suite (single site).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run only the integration test suite (single site).
scripts-descriptions.test:multisite: Run the PHPUnit suite on a multisite network.
scripts-descriptions.test:wp: Run the suite on PHP 8.2 and 8.4 x minimum and latest WordPress x single site and multisite, then check the readme.txt WordPress headers.
scripts-descriptions.test:defects: Run only the @group known-defect tests. They fail until the bug each one documents is fixed.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the suite with code coverage into build/coverage/ (needs pcov or Xdebug).
scripts-descriptions.e2e:install: Install the Node dev dependencies (npm ci) and Playwright's Chromium for the e2e suite. Needs Node 22 (nvm use).
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run the Playwright e2e, accessibility and visual suite on both Local sites (needs npm run e2e:setup:local once). Not part of composer check.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:local: Run the e2e suite on the Local single site only.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:network: Run the e2e suite on the Local multisite network only.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:wp-env: Run the e2e suite on the disposable wp-env single site and network (latest WordPress; npm run env:start and env:start:ms first).
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:wp-env:min: Run the e2e suite on wp-env with the minimum supported WordPress, then switch back to the latest.
scripts-descriptions.test:a11y: Run only the accessibility scans (axe-core) on wp-env.
scripts-descriptions.test:visual: Compare the visual baselines in tests/e2e/__screenshots__ on wp-env (latest WordPress).
scripts-descriptions.check: The quality gate the pre-push hook enforces: version check, WPCS on changed files and on the tests, PHP compatibility, PHPStan, PHPUnit.
scripts-descriptions.check:all: The full gate: WPCS on every file and on the tests, PHP compatibility, PHPStan and the PHPUnit matrix. Fails until the pre-existing WPCS backlog is cleared.
scripts-descriptions.hooks:install: Point git at the committed .githooks/ directory (runs automatically after composer install/update).
